title: Vector bundles extend across codimension two on a regular surface
statement: Let $X$ be an integral Noetherian regular scheme [def-pc-integral-scheme, def-weil-regular-scheme] of Krull dimension at most two [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring], and let $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ be an open subscheme such that $\dim\mathcal O_{X,x}\geq2$ for every $x\in X\setminus U$. Restriction from finite locally free $\mathcal O_X$-modules to finite locally free $\mathcal O_U$-modules [def-sc-finite-locally-free-sheaf] is an equivalence of categories, with inverse $j_*$. In particular, $j_*V$ is finite locally free for every finite locally free $V$ on $U$, the restriction $(j_*V)|_U\to V$ is an isomorphism, and every map between two bundles on $U$ extends uniquely between their extensions on $X$.

source.place: Tag 0EBJ (lemma-reflexive-S2-extend), combined with Tag 0B3N (lemma-reflexive-over-regular-dim-2); finite locally free form used in Section 2, Claim 2 of Alper--Halpern-Leistner--Heinloth.

proof.text: The open subscheme $U$ is regular: its local rings are the corresponding local rings of $X$, which are regular local rings. Both schemes are locally Noetherian. Also $\dim U\leq\dim X\leq2$: taking closures in $X$ sends a strict chain of irreducible closed subsets of $U$ to a strict chain in $X$, since intersecting these closures with $U$ recovers the original chain. Restriction preserves finite locally free modules, by restricting their local trivializations.

source.place: Setup for Tag 0B3N (lemma-reflexive-over-regular-dim-2), applied to X and its open subscheme; elementary restriction and dimension observations.

proof.text: On either $T=X$ or $T=U$, a finite locally free module is quasi-coherent of finite type: refine a trivializing cover by affine opens $\operatorname{Spec}A$, where it is $\widetilde{A^{\oplus r}}$ and has its finite standard generators. The coherent/finite-type criterion therefore makes it coherent. Applying the regular-dimension-two reflexivity criterion on each $T$ now identifies the finite locally free modules with the coherent reflexive modules. These are full subcategories of the same module category, so the identification keeps every module morphism.

The regular scheme $X$ is normal by the first clause of the regular-normal theorem. It is integral and locally Noetherian, and every omitted point has local dimension at least two by hypothesis. Apply the normal reflexive open-equivalence theorem to this very inclusion $j$. For a bundle $V$ on $U$, step 2 makes $V$ coherent reflexive, so $j_*V$ is coherent reflexive and the counit $(j_*V)|_U\to V$ is an isomorphism. The regular-dimension-two criterion on $X$ makes this actual direct image $j_*V$ finite locally free. For a bundle $E$ on $X$, the same equivalence gives the natural unit $\eta_E:E\to j_*(E|_U)$ as an isomorphism. Thus restriction and this direct image are quasi-inverse on the bundle categories.

source.place: Tag 0569 (properties-lemma-regular-normal); Tag 0EBJ (divisors-lemma-reflexive-S2-extend) in its existing normal specialization; Tag 0B3N (divisors-lemma-reflexive-over-regular-dim-2).

proof.text: Explicitly, for bundles $E,F$ on $X$ and a morphism $a:E|_U\to F|_U$, its extension is $\eta_F^{-1}\circ j_*a\circ\eta_E$. The unit/counit identities show its restriction is $a$. If $b:E\to F$ is any extension, naturality of the unit gives $\eta_F\circ b=j_*a\circ\eta_E$, forcing the displayed formula. This proves existence and uniqueness for all maps, including maps between the direct-image extensions of two bundles on $U$.

lean.statement: theorem regularSurfaceVectorBundleExtension (X U : Scheme.{u}) [IsIntegral X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [CompactSpace X] (hregular : IsRegularScheme X) (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X ≤ 2) (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] (hcodim : ∀ x : X, x ∉ Set.range j → 2 ≤ ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk x)) : (∀ E : X.Modules, E.IsFiniteLocallyFree → ((restrictFunctor j).obj E).IsFiniteLocallyFree ∧ IsIso ((restrictAdjunction j).unit.app E)) ∧ (∀ V : U.Modules, V.IsFiniteLocallyFree → ((pushforward j).obj V).IsFiniteLocallyFree ∧ IsIso ((restrictAdjunction j).counit.app V)) ∧ (∀ (E F : X.Modules), E.IsFiniteLocallyFree → F.IsFiniteLocallyFree → ∀ a : (restrictFunctor j).obj E ⟶ (restrictFunctor j).obj F, ∃! b : E ⟶ F, (restrictFunctor j).map b = a) ∧ (∃ e : (SheafOfModules.isFiniteLocallyFree X.ringCatSheaf).FullSubcategory ≌ (SheafOfModules.isFiniteLocallyFree U.ringCatSheaf).FullSubcategory, Nonempty (e.functor ⋙ (SheafOfModules.isFiniteLocallyFree U.ringCatSheaf).ι ≅ (SheafOfModules.isFiniteLocallyFree X.ringCatSheaf).ι ⋙ restrictFunctor j) ∧ Nonempty (e.inverse ⋙ (SheafOfModules.isFiniteLocallyFree X.ringCatSheaf).ι ≅ (SheafOfModules.isFiniteLocallyFree U.ringCatSheaf).ι ⋙ pushforward j))
